exception.message: insert or update on table "provider_package_entitlements" violates foreign key constraint "provider_package_entitlements_provider_id_fkey"
exception.fk_definition: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

timing.last_successful_checkpoint: ensure-agreements (2000 ACTIVE) — entitlements had no durable checkpoint

root_cause.summary: provider_package_entitlements.provider_id FK requires organizations(id). Cloud project had 1000 providers and 0 organizations. Org upsert omitted created_at/updated_at (NOT NULL, no DB default) and/or set legacy_provider_id on provider rows (violates organizations_customer_provider_presence_chk: provider ⇒ legacy_provider_id IS NULL). Upsert errors were swallowed, so parent rows never persisted and every entitlement upsert failed with 23503.
root_cause.not_root_cause: serial-and-too-slow alone — failure was FK integrity, not timeout
root_cause.secondary_constraint: CHECK ((((type = 'provider'::org_type) AND (legacy_provider_id IS NULL)) OR ((type = 'customer'::org_type) AND (legacy_provider_id IS NOT NULL))))
